nodes.description: Public token symbol string storage variable, set in constructor to 'DKS'.
Public token name string storage variable, set in constructor to 'Ducks'.
Public uint8 decimals storage variable, set in constructor to 8.
Total token supply storage variable, set in constructor to 500000000000000000.
Mapping(address => uint) holding token balances; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding allowances; mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
SafeMath helper adding two uints and requiring c >= a to prevent overflow.
SafeMath helper subtracting two uints, requiring b <= a to prevent underflow.
SafeMath helper multiplying two uints with a division-based overflow check.
SafeMath helper dividing two uints, requiring a non-zero divisor.
DucksToken constructor: sets metadata, mints total supply to the owner address and emits Transfer.
ERC20 view returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
ERC20 view returning the balance of the supplied tokenOwner address.
Public transfer moving tokens from msg.sender to the 'to' address using safeSub/safeAdd.
Public approve setting allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emitting Approval.
Public transferFrom moving tokens from 'from' to 'to' while decrementing the caller's allowance.
ERC20 view returning the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Public approveAndCall setting allowance then invoking receiveApproval on the spender contract.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner and allowance key throughout the contract.
safeSub decrementing balances[msg.sender] inside transfer; arithmetic underflow guarded only by require.
safeAdd incrementing balances[to] inside transfer; arithmetic overflow guarded only by require.
Untrusted external call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed in approveAndCall before state is finalised, exposing reentrancy.
safeSub decrementing allowed[from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom; arithmetic underflow guarded only by require.
Multiplication a * b inside safeMul whose overflow check depends on division truncation semantics.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf/allowance identifying the account queried.
Parameter spender of approve/approveAndCall naming the address granted allowance.
Parameter tokens of transfer/transferFrom/approve/approveAndCall giving the amount acted upon.
Parameter 'to' of transfer/transferFrom naming the recipient address.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom naming the source account whose balance is debited.
Arbitrary bytes 'data' parameter of approveAndCall forwarded to the external contract.
First uint operand 'a' of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
Second uint operand 'b' of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
Local return variable 'c' holding the result computed by each SafeMath helper.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the token symbol state variable.
Constructor sets the total supply state variable.
Constructor mints the whole supply into balances of the fixed owner address.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply when computing the circulating supply.
balanceOf() reads the balances mapping for the supplied address.
allowance() reads the allowed mapping for the (owner, spender) pair.
msg.sender is the caller-controlled balance owner debited in transfer.
msg.sender keys the allowance slot written by approve.
msg.sender identifies the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
msg.sender keys the allowance slot and is passed as 'from' to receiveApproval.
The caller-controlled msg.sender is forwarded into the untrusted external receiveApproval call.
The caller balance is read from balances and passed into safeSub for subtraction.
The recipient balance is read from balances and passed into safeAdd for addition.
Balances of 'from' are read before being decremented in transferFrom.
The allowance slot allowed[from][msg.sender] is read and decremented in transferFrom.
The user-supplied tokens amount is the subtrahend in the transfer balance decrement.
The user-supplied tokens amount is the addend in the recipient balance increment.
The user-supplied tokens amount reduces the recorded allowance in transferFrom.
transfer invokes safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer executes the balance subtraction operation on balances[msg.sender].
transfer executes the balance addition operation on balances[to].
transferFrom invokes safeSub for both the balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom executes the allowance subtraction operation allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall makes an external callback into the spender contract via receiveApproval, allowing reentrancy into allowance-dependent paths.
The unvalidated bytes data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
tokenOwner parameter selects the mapping entry returned by balanceOf.
spender parameter determines which address receives the allowance in approve.
The 'to' parameter determines the transfer recipient address.
The 'from' parameter determines whose balance transferFrom may move without explicit owner consent.
safeMul performs the raw multiplication whose overflow check may be bypassed.
Operand 'a' feeds directly into the multiplication inside safeMul.
Operand 'b' feeds directly into the multiplication inside safeMul.
Operand 'a' is added to 'b' inside safeAdd.
Operand 'b' is added to 'a' inside safeAdd.
Operand 'a' is the minuend subtracted from in safeSub.
Operand 'b' is the subtrahend in safeSub and is required to be <= a.
safeAdd stores its computed result into local variable c before returning.
safeSub stores its computed result into local variable c before returning.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter tokenOwner exists only to index the balances mapping read by balanceOf and carries no independent identity.
Parameter spender is only the allowance key written by approve and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter tokens is the amount consumed by the transfer balance arithmetic and has no standalone semantic role.
Parameter 'to' is merely the recipient slot used by transfer's balance credit.
Parameter 'from' is the source account debited by transferFrom and should collapse into that function.
Parameter data is opaque payload passed through by approveAndCall to the external callback and adds no graph semantics.
Operand a is an anonymous arithmetic input of the SafeMath helpers and should be merged into the function that consumes it.
Operand b is an anonymous arithmetic input of the SafeMath helpers and should be merged into the function that consumes it.
Local c is only the temporary result holder of the SafeMath helpers and is subsumed by the operation producing it.
